## Classes

### <a name="trusted_ca"></a>`trusted_ca`

Manage distribution's trusted certificates

#### Examples

##### Installation

```puppet
include trusted_ca

trusted_ca::ca { 'example.org.local':
  source => 'puppet:///data/ssl/example.com.pem',
}
```

##### <a name="-trusted_ca--certificates_version"></a>`certificates_version`

Data type: `String`

This can be set to `present` or `latest` or a specific version to choose the distribution specific package

Default value: `'installed'`

##### <a name="-trusted_ca--path"></a>`path`

Data type: `Variant[Array[String], String]`

Search path (`$PATH`) used to execute `$trusted_ca::update_command`

Default value: `$trusted_ca::params::path`

##### <a name="-trusted_ca--install_path"></a>`install_path`

Data type: `Stdlib::Absolutepath`

Location to install the trusted certificates

Default value: `$trusted_ca::params::install_path`

##### <a name="-trusted_ca--update_command"></a>`update_command`

Data type: `String`

Command to rebuild the system-trusted certificates

Default value: `$trusted_ca::params::update_command`

##### <a name="-trusted_ca--certfile_suffix"></a>`certfile_suffix`

Data type: `String`

Suffix of certificate files. Default is OS/Distribution dependent, i.e. `pem` or `crt`

Default value: `$trusted_ca::params::certfile_suffix`

##### <a name="-trusted_ca--certs_package"></a>`certs_package`

Data type: `String`

Package name of the distribution-specific trusted certificates. Default is OS/Distribution specific

Default value: `$trusted_ca::params::certs_package`

## Defined types

### <a name="trusted_ca--ca"></a>`trusted_ca::ca`

Install individual root CAs

#### Examples

##### Installation

```puppet
include trusted_ca

trusted_ca::ca { 'example.org.local':
  source => 'puppet:///data/ssl/example.com.pem',
}

trusted_ca::ca { 'example.net.local':
  content  => lookup('example-net-x509'),
}
```

#### Parameters

The following parameters are available in the `trusted_ca::ca` defined type:

* [`source`](#-trusted_ca--ca--source)
* [`content`](#-trusted_ca--ca--content)
* [`install_path`](#-trusted_ca--ca--install_path)
* [`certfile_suffix`](#-trusted_ca--ca--certfile_suffix)

##### <a name="-trusted_ca--ca--source"></a>`source`

Data type: `Optional[String]`

Path to the certificate PEM.
Must specify either content or source.

Default value: `undef`

##### <a name="-trusted_ca--ca--content"></a>`content`

Data type: `Optional[Pattern['^[A-Za-z0-9+/\n=-]+$']]`

Content of certificate in PEM format.
Must specify either content or source.

Default value: `undef`

##### <a name="-trusted_ca--ca--install_path"></a>`install_path`

Data type: `Stdlib::Absolutepath`

Location to install trusted certificates

Default value: `$trusted_ca::install_path`

##### <a name="-trusted_ca--ca--certfile_suffix"></a>`certfile_suffix`

Data type: `String`

The suffix of the certificate to install.
Default is OS/Distribution dependent, i.e. `crt` or `pem`

Default value: `$trusted_ca::certfile_suffix`

### <a name="trusted_ca--java"></a>`trusted_ca::java`

install certs to a java cacerts file

#### Examples

##### Installation

```puppet
include trusted_ca

trusted_ca::java { 'example.org.local':
  source => 'puppet:///data/ssl/example.com.pem',
}

trusted_ca::java { 'example.net.local':
  content  => lookup('example-net-x509'),
}
```

#### Parameters

The following parameters are available in the `trusted_ca::java` defined type:

* [`java_keystore`](#-trusted_ca--java--java_keystore)
* [`source`](#-trusted_ca--java--source)
* [`content`](#-trusted_ca--java--content)
* [`filename`](#-trusted_ca--java--filename)

##### <a name="-trusted_ca--java--java_keystore"></a>`java_keystore`

Data type: `Stdlib::Absolutepath`

Location of java cacerts file
This must be specified - there is no default.

##### <a name="-trusted_ca--java--source"></a>`source`

Data type: `Optional[String]`

Path to the certificate PEM.
Must specify either content or source.

Default value: `undef`

##### <a name="-trusted_ca--java--content"></a>`content`

Data type: `Optional[Pattern['^[A-Za-z0-9+/\n=-]+$']]`

Content of certificate in PEM format.
Must specify either content or source.

Default value: `undef`

##### <a name="-trusted_ca--java--filename"></a>`filename`

Data type: `Stdlib::Absolutepath`

The intermediate filename to use

Default value: `"/tmp/${name}-trustedca"`
